name: Sliced Ham
description: A simple baked ham recipe with a brown sugar, mustard, and allspice topping.
recipeIngredient: 6 slices ham, about ½ inch thick

recipeInstructions.text: Place ham slices on a cookie sheet.
Mix brown sugar, dry mustard, and allspice together. Sprinkle over ham slices.
Bake in 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes, turning once and sprinkling additional mixture on the other side.

keywords: baked ham, glazed ham, sweet ham

_similar.name: Glazed Cottage Roll
_similar.description: A sweet and savory glazed cottage roll baked with a mustard and brown sugar crust.

recipeInstructions.text: Remove outer wrapper from cottage roll. Place in large saucepan and cover with water. Add bay leaf, cloves, garlic and onion.
Bring to a boil, cover pan and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 1½ to 2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 170°F (75°C).
Lift meat from water and remove netting. Place in shallow pan or casserole dish.
Blend mustard and brown sugar together. Spread over cottage roll.
Bake in 425°F (220°C) oven for 15 minutes, basting occasionally, until glaze is set.

_similar.keywords: glazed cottage roll, baked ham, sweet glaze

_similar.name: Chicken Celebrity
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Beef Porcupines
_similar.description: Baked meatballs with rice, served in a tangy tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, mustard, chili powder, salt, allspice, brown sugar, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and paprika. Form into balls.
Place meatballs in a baking dish.
Combine tomato soup and hot water to make the sauce. Pour over meatballs.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Sticky Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish baked in a sticky sauce with pineapple and mushrooms.

recipeInstructions.text: Shake chicken pieces in a bag with flour, paprika, ginger, and garlic powder to coat.
Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, soya sauce, and drained mushrooms. Mix well.
Place the coated chicken in a pan, skin side down. Pour the sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F, uncovered, for 1 hour. Baste often and turn the chicken at 30 minutes.
During the last 5 minutes, add drained pineapple tidbits and an additional can of drained mushrooms.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken, baked chicken, pineapple chicken
